chunks: As for what ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated, he said: Dāwūd ibn Farqad asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام
about sheets and papers upon which there is writing: is sajdah upon them permissible or not? So he wrote: It is permissible.

key_terms.الْقَرَاطِيسِ: writing sheets or leaves used as a material surface
key_terms.الْمَكْتُوبِ: that upon which writing is present
key_terms.يَجُوزُ: it is permissible or legally allowed

ai.seo_question: Is sajdah on written paper permissible according to Imam Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question addressed to Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام concerning whether sajdah may be performed on written paper and sheets. The Imam’s written reply states that it is permissible, making the narration relevant to prayer rulings and the materials valid for prostration.
